question: Is there a nontrivial D4 spatial operator-geometry map preserving both frozen public charge actions that could justify reusing signed-character laws, and does any such map replay independently stored direct laws?
fork_classification: The colored red-edge graph, face/qubit incidence, full star/CZ operator geometry and held-out complete-law replays form a prerequisite chain, not a human ranking choice. Enumerate all maps under the fixed action constraints, reject failed geometry, then test every mapped J8X law; no new Born work or expanded budget is needed.

hypotheses.nontrivial_validated_map: At least one nonidentity colored graph map preserves both action sets and full D4 star/CZ geometry, maps evaluated pairs to evaluated pairs, and replays their direct public laws after the induced public-site permutation.
hypotheses.no_nontrivial_map: Only identity survives the action and full operator geometry constraints; no new-law reuse can be licensed by this restricted spatial-symmetry family.
hypotheses.law_failure: A nontrivial full-geometry map exists but a mapped direct public law disagrees; reject signed-character law reuse for that map.
hypotheses.censored: Enumeration exceeds the frozen CPU/node/map cap or geometry/source/action/identity-replay integrity fails; no partial symmetry claim is promoted.

model_boundary: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 projector/fusion instrument at p_X=1/10, p_Z=0. Use only the J6L 24-site colored red-edge graph and 108-qubit full star/CZ geometry, the J9B frozen deterministic-first class, and the two fixed relation-free public actions [0] and [1,30,32,34,35]. Private errors are used only for analysis and held-out law matching, not for action choice.

matrix.cells: Enumerate all blue/green color-preserving 24-vertex red-edge graph automorphisms fixing red edge 0 and preserving the five-edge action as a set. For each, derive the red-edge and 12-face maps, then the bijective 108-physical-qubit map. Retain only maps preserving every outer-X support, every six-CZ pair set, and color-resolved triangle-Z support for all 36 stars. For each retained map, independently transform any of the 12 J8X private-error pairs that maps into the same frozen class and compare every corresponding full public flux/charge/vacuum law under both fixed actions; report matches and mismatches, not just candidate counts.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact spatial map, with already-computed direct public laws as validation fixtures; no stochastic sampling uncertainty.
matrix.integrity: Pin J6L geometry, J8X direct laws, J9B class result and runner hashes; enforce action binding, graph/face/qubit bijections, full operator geometry, identity control, full public-array permutation, exact rational law equality and zero new Born/history/arm/bootstrap work. A graph-only symmetry is a necessary condition, not an accepted operator or law symmetry.

acceptance: All action-preserving colored graph maps are enumerated within the bound and filtered through face/qubit/full star-CZ geometry
Every candidate that maps a frozen class pair to another receives exact full-public-law replay with matches/mismatches; identity passes
Conclusions restricted to this action-preserving spatial-map family and already evaluated finite class; no uncomputed-law reuse, full-IID information/risk, noisy JIT, scaling or threshold claim
stop_rule: Stop after all bounded action-preserving colored graph maps and existing J8X direct-law validations, or first source/integrity/5-CPU-second/10,000-node/256-map cap. Do not relax action preservation, add sectors, evaluate new Born laws or expand compute.
